chapter.title: SentencePiece model loading and persistence
chapter.para: The subword module reads SentencePiece models in Java. Model parsing rejects fields crossing an enclosing message boundary, malformed UTF-8, oversized varints, invalid field numbers and non-ASCII hexadecimal byte pieces.

SentencePieceTokenizer.serialize(OutputStream) writes a Java object stream. deserialize(InputStream) restores it with a fixed class allow-list and resource limits. Both methods close the supplied stream. Only use trusted serialized models. Ordinary ObjectInputStream calls do not install this filter automatically.

Default limits are depth 64, 5,000,000 references and 10,000,000 elements per array. The overload accepting DeserializationLimits allows different positive limits without changing the class allow-list. These limits do not cap total serialized bytes or validate every field of a forged object.
The serialization API changes the computed serial version from the base addons tokenizer. Rebuild Java object streams from the original SentencePiece .model files when moving to this research branch.
